summary: Hunter injured by a muzzleloader misfire west of Rocky Mountain National Park between Bowen Gulch Trail and Blue Lake; RMNP team reached the hunter first, then met GCSAR; hunter walked out with support and was transported to Estes Park Health.
location: Between Bowen Gulch Trail and Blue Lake, west of Rocky Mountain National Park
responding_agency: Grand County Search and Rescue; Rocky Mountain National Park; Grand Lake Fire Protection District; Grand County EMS
